title: Dilemmas and Advice
grammar: Decision-Making Idioms, Deliberative Conditionals & Concession Connectors
goal: I can ask what someone would do in my place, using a helyemben.
I can give advice in a dilemma, using a helyedben + conditional.
I can talk about hesitation, doubt and resolve (habozás, kétely, elhatározás).
